summary_1line: Pandu explains ancient marital customs and asks Kunti to obtain offspring through another man; Kunti reveals a mantra to summon gods for conception.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Pandu sits in the forest with folded hands before Kunti, pleading with her to raise offspring through another for the sake of the Kuru line.
Young Swetaketu watches in anger as a Brahmana takes his mother by the hand before his calm father Uddalaka.
Kunti recounts to Pandu how the fierce sage Durvasa granted her a mantra capable of summoning any god to give her a child.
